name: Numbers I
subtitle: Build confidence with whole numbers
goals: Recognise primes, factors, multiples and decimals.
Find HCF and LCM using lists and prime factorisations.
Connect square and cube numbers to powers and roots in N.
Apply BIDMAS and explain each step.
description: Investigate primes, factors, multiples, decimals, HCF, LCM, powers, roots and order of operations.

name: Geometry I
subtitle: Reason with shapes, angles and space
goals: Classify triangles, quadrilaterals and polygons by properties.
Explain angle sums, regular polygons and parallel-line angles.
Follow compass constructions for a bisector and perpendicular bisector.
Calculate perimeter and area of single and compound shapes.
description: Explore shape properties, polygon and parallel-line angles, compass constructions, compound area and perimeter.

name: Numbers II
subtitle: Make sense of signed numbers
goals: Classify numbers using N, Z and Q.
Add, subtract, multiply and divide signed numbers.
Explain powers of negative bases, brackets and real roots.
Use BIDMAS accurately with integer inputs.
description: Investigate number sets, signed arithmetic, negative bases, powers, roots and BIDMAS with integers.

name: Algebra I
subtitle: Connect stories, tables, formulas and graphs
goals: Use variables to represent changing quantities.
Plot and read coordinates on a set of axes.
Recognise direct proportion through its constant ratio.
Recognise inverse proportion through its constant product.
description: Use variables and coordinates, then connect direct and inverse proportion to stories, tables, formulas and graphs.

name: Numbers III
subtitle: Connect ratios, fractions and percentages
goals: Share in ratios and use map scales with consistent units.
Convert fractions, decimals and percentages; form equivalent fractions.
Calculate percentage increases and discounts.
Apply the four operations and BIDMAS in positive rational numbers.
description: Explore ratio sharing, map scales, equivalent fractions, decimals, percentages, discounts and rational-number operations.

name: Algebra II
subtitle: Translate, collect, expand and solve
goals: Translate words and situations into algebraic expressions before solving.
Collect like terms and expand simple brackets.
Solve one-, two- and three-step equations, first in N and then in Z.
Solve equations with x on both sides, including an initial bracket.
description: Build expressions, collect like terms, expand brackets and solve equations with a balance of equivalent operations.

name: Statistics
subtitle: Turn data into clear displays and conclusions
goals: Construct and interpret pictograms, bar charts and pie charts.
Find mean, median, mode, range and quartiles from lists.
Use discrete frequency tables, including weighted means and ordered positions.
Interpret pie-chart proportions and justify conclusions from data.
description: Build and read charts, explore averages and quartiles, and interpret discrete frequency tables.
